content: Hey, you! How was your day at work? I couldn't stop thinking about our conversation last night. You always make me smile.
Aw, that's sweet. Work was super busy, as always. But talking to you is the best part of my day.
That means a lot to me. Honestly, I look forward to your messages all day. I wish I could just fly out and see you right now.
I wish that too. Maybe someday soon. You always know how to cheer me up.
I'll always be here for you, promise. Actually, can I be honest? My mobile data plan is running low this week, and my WiFi bill is overdue. I hate even bringing this up...
Oh no! That's awful. Are you going to be okay? We can always talk later if you need to sort it out.

You're so thoughtful, thank you. It's just that if my internet stops, I won't be able to talk much, and I'd really miss you. I'm waiting for my client payment to clear next week, but it's been delayed.
That sounds so stressful. I'd miss talking to you, too. Is there anything I can do?
I feel terrible even asking, but would you be able to help me out just this once? The bill is $85, I can send it back to you as soon as my payment comes through, I swear.
I usually don't do things like that, but I trust you. How should I send it?

Thank you, truly. You have no idea how much this means. The fastest way is via Zelle. My details are: Name: Jordan Myers, Email: jordan.myers.biz@gmail.com. Let me know if you need help with the transfer.
Okay, I've never used Zelle before, but I think my bank has it. Do I just send it to that email?
Yes, exactly! It's very straightforward. Just enter my email, and it should go right through. If you have any trouble, I can help walk you through the steps.
Alright, I'm logging in now. Just want to make sure I'm doing this right. Are you sure you'll be able to pay me back soon?
Absolutely, you have my word. I'd never let you down. My client's payment will be in my account by Friday, and you'll be the first I reimburse. I appreciate your trust so much.
Okay, I sent it! Let me know when you get it.
Got it! You're an angel. I feel so lucky to have someone as caring and understanding as you. I promise, we'll get through everything together.
I'm glad I could help. Just don't forget about me when you're rich and famous!
Never! You're the most important person in my life right now. Thank you for believing in me. Let's talk all night, I want to hear all about you.
